purpose: Teach: しまお/登勢/橘/ウチダ/岡野/石毛/田代/安井

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画家しまおさんのエッセイ読んでたな
lines.en: Riku — I saw you reading that manga artist Shimao's essay the other day.
lines.style: Casual observation wrapped in playful accusation. Raises the bar slightly on 'Shimao' like she's caught him at something harmless. Warm underneath the wry surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお祖母様、登勢さんって名前だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your grandmother's name was Tose, wasn't it, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft, almost hesitant — like he's testing whether it's okay to remember this detail about her. Genuine curiosity, not playing back. Eyes meeting hers to see if he got it right.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの橘と話してたな
lines.en: Riku — weren't you talking to that girl Tachibana from the class next door?
lines.style: Same playful catch, but with a sharper edge. She's watching for his reaction. Quick delivery, eyes narrowed slightly, knowing she's touched something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ウチダ写真機店で証明写真撮ったろ、桜
lines.en: You got your ID photo taken at Uchida Camera Shop, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter than before. Not accusatory — almost collaborative, like he's remembering out loud with her. Waiting for confirmation, not pushing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会の岡野先生厳しかったな
lines.en: Riku — Okano-sensei was pretty harsh in social studies, huh?
lines.style: Comfortable commiseration. Raises eyebrow slightly on 'harsh' like they're sharing a complaint. Conspiratorial but not mean-spirited.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、野球の石毛コーチのプレー覚えてたな、桜
lines.en: You remember that play by your baseball coach Ishige, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Lighter tone returning. There's admiration buried in the observation. Genuinely impressed she'd remember something from his world.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、田代まさしの懐かしいビデオ観てたな
lines.en: Riku — weren't you watching that old Tashiro Masashi video?
lines.style: Quick, knowing smirk in the voice. She's building a case, having fun with it. Light, almost laughing at him catching him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、塾の安井先生のクラスだったろ、桜
lines.en: You were in Yasui-sensei's cram school class, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Closer, more intimate. Slight lean-in quality to the delivery. He's showing his cards now — he knows her life. Not accusatory. Almost tender.
